name: Contempt
overview: The Scriptures warn against contempt manifested through partiality and disrespect within the community of believers, as seen in James 2:1-3 where showing favoritism to the wealthy over the poor contradicts the faith in Christ. Such contempt reflects a deeper issue of pride and a failure to honor all individuals equally before God. This attitude not only dishonors Christ but also disrupts the unity and witness of the church, calling believers to examine their hearts and actions in light of true faith.
